post_details: I saved my project file and closed the program, then came back a couple hours later to reopen the same project file. The garments were completely missing. I have uninstalled and reinstalled the program, reopened the project on another system, tried opening the png preview as a project (which has the garments in the img), tried importing the garments with that png file as well. None of these options worked. The garments arent hidden either, theyre just gone now I don't know where my garments went and why its still visible on the png if when I open the save, theyre absent? Link to files: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1yqHod0vojIYJbrnteBvtWF3OzlsNy-6_?usp=sharing
post_description: This page serves as a support resource for users experiencing issues with missing garments in their project files, providing troubleshooting steps and a link to relevant files for further assistance.

comments.comment_body: Hello 902295519486 File recovery was successful. Download it from the link below. https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Zsf96v3iY8yHqO523iCjpUmIzrRn77LD/view?usp=sharing It seems that there are two or three people who worked on the file you've shared.
